mintAuthority.summary: KGST is a TransparentUpgradeableProxy on BSC. The token owner (Ownable) and the ProxyAdmin are both controlled by a 2/5 Gnosis Safe (0xb94f9247). The Safe has no modules enabled. Mint gated by owner role held by that Safe.

controls.label: KGST issuer 2/5 Gnosis Safe (token owner + ProxyAdmin owner)
controls.evidence: At BSC block 103800563: KGST token (0x94be0bba) is a TransparentUpgradeableProxy. owner() returns 0xb94f9247bd181fc9aca4d8694fb3774ed99be5d5. EIP-1967 proxy admin slot = 0xcb628ce396f8f6ffbfae48721fe02a668a9a718b (ProxyAdmin contract); ProxyAdmin.owner() also returns 0xb94f9247. Reading 0xb94f9247 via RPC: ownerCount=5 (slot 3), threshold=2 (slot 4), getOwners() returns 5 addresses above. getModulesPaginated() returns empty array (no modules). Safe singleton = 0x29fcb43b (GnosisSafe v1.3 on BSC).
